headline: LEARNED WALK ships: a walker the network taught itself
lede: Slot a closed #1205: the PHYSICS WALK biped minus its hand-written controller, steered by one 707-param MLP trained in-repo ((1+1)-ES, Cauchy mutation, stand-walk-refine). It walks 3.4 m net in 10 s where the bare rig moves 0.1 m — and still topples on every seed, honestly framed on-page. One command reproduces the policy byte-for-byte.

notes.text: Serialization is a knife edge: an unrounded 2.98 m policy face-planted at tick 35 after JSON round-trip to 4 decimals. The trainer now searches in quantized space and re-scores the serialized bytes against the bare rig before accepting (ship-honesty gate).
Uniform-mutation CEM never beat the zero-torque rig; (1+1)-ES with Cauchy tails did. Method archaeology is in the trainer header so the next lane doesn't re-litigate it.

creditscheck DEMOS list had drifted (deepglass/stickwalk/learnedwalk missing) — fixed; one red remains: reef index card still cites issues [902] vs the page's [1050,1093]. One-line fix for whoever is near.
learnedwalkcheck 30/30; mirror mutant (hipR torque to 0) reddens six gates — demonstrated and restored, same discipline as the mutant essays.
